name: Spell Cone
description: Overrides the cone angle used by cone-shaped spell effects (default is 60 degrees). Entries must be defined for the first rank of a spell and all ranks must use the same angle.

fields.name: Spell
fields.help: Cone angle is looked up by the first rank of the spell chain

fields.name: Cone Degrees
fields.help: Width of the cone in degrees; negative value = cone behind the caster
